rundown: Zips beat Green Wave 65-63 at James A. Rhodes Arena in Akron, OH. Zips led 36-26 at half-time and held on.
Leading the way — Green Wave: TJ Nadeau 19 pts; KJ Greene 3 ast; Tyler Ringgold 8 reb. Zips: Ty Pence 17 pts; Evan Mahaffey 5 ast; Chabi Barre 10 reb.
Where Zips won it: they shot 40% to 36%, won the boards 46-35 and had 15 assists to 8.
Against the closing line (Draft Kings): Zips closed as 11.5-point favorites and won but didn't cover (Green Wave +11.5 cashed); the total closed at 155.5 and they combined for 128, under by 27.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 14, 11:57 AM ET. It had Green Wave 20% and Zips 80%, projecting Green Wave 76.7 – Zips 86 (162.7 total, Zips by 9.3).

Final: Green Wave 63 – Zips 65. Right winner: it had Zips at 80%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Green Wave came in with a league-average attack and a 3% leakier than average defense (2-1, 87.3 scored and 82.7 allowed a game over 3 games), worth about 172 and 170 games of evidence. Projected to score 76.7, they scored 63 (−13.7 points, 18% under); projected to allow 86, they allowed 65 (−21 points, 24% under).

Zips came in with a 4% above average attack and a 2% stingier than average defense (2-0, 93.5 scored and 62.5 allowed a game over 2 games), worth about 157 and 157 games of evidence. Projected to score 86, they scored 65 (−21 points, 24% under); projected to allow 76.7, they allowed 63 (−13.7 points, 18% under).

The bigger miss was Zips' scoring (-21 points against projection); both sides underscored their projections, so the game ran colder than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 128 against 162.7 projected (-34.7), about the 1st percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±14.5).

Margin: Zips by 2 against Zips by 9.3 projected, about the 25th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±11).

An outlier: the simulations had a result this far off less than about 5% of the time, which usually means an input was wrong or missing, not just bad luck.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Market (Line movement signal): Zips ×1.00, Green Wave ×1.02. It favored Green Wave, who did beat their projection by more than the other side did.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
AKR ML (-800) at -800: the algo gave it 85% vs 85% fair (-0.3 pts) — won (+0.1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 85%). TULN ML (+550) at +550: the algo gave it 15% vs 15% fair (+0.3 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 15%). AKR -11.5 (-118) at -118: the algo gave it 51% vs 52% fair (-0.6 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. TULN +11.5 (-102) at -102: the algo gave it 49% vs 48% fair (+0.6 pts) — won (+1u); same number as the close. OVER 155.5 (-115) at -115: the algo gave it 52% vs 51% fair (+1.1 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. UNDER 155.5 (-105) at -105: the algo gave it 48% vs 49% fair (-1.1 pts) — won (+1u); same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 50% of bets on Green Wave, 58% of the money — Green Wave covered; total: 61% of bets on the over, 64% of the money — it went under; moneyline: 4% of bets on Green Wave, 2% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Green Wave, who lost and covered.

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin.

The projection missed by a lot, so those flags likely mattered here.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.780 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -6.2 points. It counts toward CBB scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 495 graded CBB games the algo now scales scoring ×0.990 and gives home teams +1.1 points. Team corrections so far: Green Wave attack ×0.988, defense ×0.985 (3 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total outside its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
